title: GO Command Center Signed Failure Evidence V1
description: The machine-verifiable record of a Task whose execution attempt was claimed and then failed. Published by the Hong Kong Agent to chenzhenxi1-sudo/go-control-evidence under evidence/<task_id>-<nonce>.json, exactly where a success record would go, signed with the same evidence identity. Before CC V1-02 a failure touched only the agent-local SQLite ledger, so the control bus could not distinguish 'never picked up' from 'picked up and failed'.

task_id.description: the original Task id; never dropped on failure

nonce.description: the original Task nonce; never dropped on failure

action_id.description: the original Task action; never dropped on failure

executor_version.description: a real executor version when one reported it, otherwise the honest literal 'not_dispatched' or 'unreported'. Never a fabricated version.

gate_results.description: PASS, FAIL or NOT_EVALUATED per validation gate, so the record shows where the attempt stopped

kind.description: closed set; an unmapped stage is AGENT_REJECT, never the raw text

stage.description: closed internal vocabulary describing where the attempt stopped. `artifact_durability` is separate from `evidence_build` on purpose: a build that succeeded but produced no durable artifact is neither an executor refusal nor a publication failure, and reading it as either would hide the ephemeral-artifact defect (a SIGned TEST_PR whose built image the executor then deleted).

reason_code.description: closed set. Free-form diagnostic text is never echoed; anything outside this set is reported as UNCLASSIFIED_REJECT.

diagnostic.description: redacted, length-bounded process output. This is a diagnostic, not the Evidence: the Evidence is the signed envelope around it.

signature.description: Ed25519, base64. Verifies against /etc/go-hk-agent/keys/evidence-signing.pub, published in the repository as identity/keys/hk-evidence-signing.pub.

x-go-semantics: A failure record is published only for a Task whose single execution attempt was claimed. Claiming is what 'picked up' means.

A Task rejected before the claim publishes nothing at all. In particular a Task whose own signature never verified is never reported on: otherwise whoever can write a task file could cause a write into the control bus.
retry_permitted, replay_authorized and authorizes_any_action are always false. A failure record authorizes nothing. The one-attempt rule is enforced by the agent ledger, not by this document.
A failed publication of a failure record is not a success and does not release the attempt budget. It is reported as EVIDENCE_NOT_PUBLISHED.

One Task identity has at most one Evidence record. A second record for the same task_id and nonce is refused rather than merged or overwritten, and a reader that sees two distinct records for one signed Task must fail closed.
